Review limitations: possible missed studies, subjective quality assessment, extraction inconsistencies, publication bias, 2022-2025 and English-only scope, variable definition of 'agentic', metric diversity, small subcategories, heterogeneity; meta-analysis not possible (53 studies reported Pass@k but data sufficient only for 28; funnel plot suggests negative results under-represented). Gaps: no standardized evaluation frameworks/benchmarks for comparing agentic approaches; coordination mechanisms; long-term maintainability of agent-generated code; human-agent collaboration guidelines; real-world and longitudinal studies; security, explainability, ethics

Not about SDD. Protocol not registered publicly, provided as supplementary material; full search strings and kappa values per criterion also in the supplementary material (not seen).
